message_text_trgm_idx.name: message_text_trgm_idx
message_text_trgm_idx.where: "app"."message"."role" in ('user', 'assistant') and "app"."message"."kind" = 'normal' and "app"."message"."text" is not null

run_outcome_text_trgm_idx.name: run_outcome_text_trgm_idx
run_outcome_text_trgm_idx.where: "app"."run"."parent_run_id" is null and "app"."run"."outcome" is not null

thread_folder_project_check.name: thread_folder_project_check
thread_folder_project_check.value: "app"."thread"."folder_id" is null or "app"."thread"."project_id" is not null

tenant.name: tenant
tenant.using: org_id = (select app.org_id()) and (scope <> 'personal' or scope_id = (select app.user_id()))
tenant.withCheck: org_id = (select app.org_id()) and (scope <> 'personal' or scope_id = (select app.user_id()))

tenant.name: tenant
tenant.using:
org_id = (select app.org_id()) and exists (
  select 1 from app.context_item i where i.org_id = context_item_version.org_id and i.id = context_item_version.item_id)
tenant.withCheck:
org_id = (select app.org_id()) and exists (
  select 1 from app.context_item i where i.org_id = context_item_version.org_id and i.id = context_item_version.item_id)

artifact_folder_project_check.name: artifact_folder_project_check
artifact_folder_project_check.value: "app"."artifact"."folder_id" is null or "app"."artifact"."project_id" is not null

eval_case_reference_check.name: eval_case_reference_check
eval_case_reference_check.value: "app"."eval_case"."reference_spec" is not null or "app"."eval_case"."reference_sql" is not null
